Educational estimates only — not financial advice. Each contract = 100 shares.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick call or put, then enter strike, premium and contracts.
  2. Drag the price-at-expiry slider (or type a price).
  3. Read P/L, break-evens, max profit and max loss.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is option P/L calculated?

Call P/L per share = max(price − strike, 0) − premium. Put P/L per share = max(strike − price, 0) − premium. Multiply by 100 shares per contract and your contract count.

What are the break-even prices?

Call break-even = strike + premium; put break-even = strike − premium. Past that price the position turns profitable at expiry.

What are max profit and max loss?

Long call max profit is theoretically unlimited; long put max profit = (strike − premium) × 100 × contracts; max loss for both = premium paid.
